mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 60 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Verona City Hall and a full moon overhead. Tonight's low will hit 58 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Public Works crews are preparing for Fall Leaf Collection starting Monday, October 5, and the Planning Department is alerting citizens to be cautious of fraudulent emails requesting payment for zoning fees via wire transfer.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music at Bailey's Run, the Verona Fall Fest, and music at Lake Lou-ee all happening tomorrow. Plus, check out the Downtown Farmer's Market on September 30.
In our weekly report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where they apprehended a suspect after a reported gunshot and property damage.
Culver's is closed for the evening, but we will be ready to serve you tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM.
